verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a knowledge-base product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-page actions: listing pages in a scope, writing or editing a page, adding notes, and moving or deleting pages. None of it documents applying one operation to many items at once. Loading docs into a scope and syncing from Slack or Monday are ingestion and sync features, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
